summary: The test suite covers core requirements (classification logic, both output formats, error handling, workflow structure) with 22 test cases across three files. However, critical gaps limit confidence: (1) fixture files referenced in tests but not provided (`.actrc`, `fixtures/secrets.json`, `tests/cases/*.json`, `tests-structure/wf.py`) — workflow.bats will fail if the Python helper script is missing; (2) edge cases untested (empty configs, negative/float warning-days, missing secret fields, very old/future dates, secrets with null/empty required_by); (3) classification thresholds tested at only 5 specific points, not exhaustively; (4) error messages checked for presence, not content/exactness; (5) no verification that all input fields survive the pipeline, only specific named values. Tests are well-organized with clear naming and good use of setup(), but coupling to fixture values and reliance on an external Python parser (for workflow verification) creates brittleness. The suite would catch regressions in classification logic and output formatting, but might miss subtle bugs in edge cases and will have immediate test failures if fixture files are absent.
